# Upload

Chooses files and shows them in a list with their progress. Upload does not send requests by itself: set
`customRequest` (your own request with `onProgress` / `onSuccess` / `onError`) or `action` (an address that
receives a POST); without either, files are only added to the list, for example to be sent with a form. Use
`Upload.Dropzone` for a drop area.

By default every file type is accepted and there is no size limit: set `accept` and `maxSize` (also check them
on the server), and handle rejected files with `onReject`.

**Interaction**: pressing the trigger opens the file dialog and focus stays on the trigger. In the list, failed
files show "Upload failed" and a "Retry" button that sends the same request again; "Remove" cancels an upload in
progress, and focus moves to the next file (or back to the trigger when the list is empty). The drop area has a
filled background with a dashed outline (the outline marks where files can be dropped); while files are dragged
over it, it turns to a subtle accent background with an accent outline. It is focusable with `Tab`, and `Enter` /
`Space` open the file dialog.

**Category**: Basic · **Common uses**: Attachments of a form, importing a file, uploading images

## Import

```ts
import { Upload } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Upload does not send requests by itself: here `customRequest` uploads the file and reports progress. Set `accept`
and `maxSize` (there are no defaults, so every type and size would be accepted) and tell the user about rejected
files in `onReject`.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  const [rejected, setRejected] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const reasons: Record<UploadRejectReason, string> = {
    type: 'only PDF and Word documents are accepted',
    size: 'files must be 10 MB or smaller',
  }
  return (
    <Stack gap={2}>
      <Upload
        accept=".pdf,.docx"
        maxSize={10 * MB}
        multiple
        customRequest={simulate()}
        onReject={(file, reason) => setRejected(`${file.name}: ${reasons[reason]}`)}
      >
        <Button icon={<Icon name="upload" />}>Choose files</Button>
      </Upload>
      {rejected && (
        <Text tone="danger" size="sm">
          {rejected}
        </Text>
      )}
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Drop area

`Upload.Dropzone` accepts files dragged onto it, and opens the file dialog on click or `Enter` / `Space`. Put the
accepted types and the size limit in `hint`.

```tsx
export function Dropzone() {
  return (
    <Upload.Dropzone
      accept="image/png,image/jpeg"
      maxSize={20 * MB}
      multiple
      hint="PNG or JPG, up to 20 MB each"
      customRequest={simulate()}
    />
  )
}
```

## States

### Failed uploads and retry

A failed file shows "Upload failed" and a "Retry" button that sends the same request again; here the first
attempt of every file fails. Files that failed before the page was loaded (without a request to repeat) can only
be removed.

```tsx
export function Retry() {
  const [attempts] = useState(() => new Map<string, number>())
  return (
    <Upload
      accept=".csv"
      maxSize={5 * MB}
      customRequest={simulate((file) => {
        const n = (attempts.get(file.name) ?? 0) + 1
        attempts.set(file.name, n)
        return n === 1
      })}
      defaultFileList={[
        { uid: 'contacts', name: 'contacts.csv', size: 48_200, status: 'done' },
        { uid: 'orders', name: 'orders-march.csv', size: 1_250_000, status: 'error' },
      ]}
    >
      <Button icon={<Icon name="upload" />}>Import CSV</Button>
    </Upload>
  )
}
```

## Advanced

### Files for a form

Without `action` and `customRequest`, nothing is sent: chosen files are only added to the list, and the form
sends them on submit. `disabled` hides "Remove" and does not open the dialog.

```tsx
export function WithoutRequest() {
  return (
    <Stack gap={4}>
      <Upload accept=".pdf" maxSize={10 * MB} maxCount={3} multiple>
        <Button>Attach PDFs</Button>
      </Upload>
      <Upload.Dropzone
        disabled
        hint="Uploads are paused"
        defaultFileList={[{ uid: 'brief', name: 'project-brief.pdf', size: 820_000 }]}
      />
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accept` | `string` | Accepted file types: comma-separated extensions and MIME types, such as `".pdf,image/png,image/*"`. Checked for chosen and dropped files; rejected files are not added to the list and `onReject` is called. By default every type is accepted. | — | No |
| `maxSize` | `number` | Maximum size of one file in bytes, such as `10 * 1024 * 1024` for 10 MB. Larger files are not added to the list and `onReject` is called. There is no limit by default; the server must check the size as well. | — | No |
| `onReject` | `(file: File, reason: UploadRejectReason) => void` | Called for each file rejected by `accept` (`reason` is `type`) or `maxSize` (`size`), for example to show a message. | — | No |
| `customRequest` | `(options: UploadRequestOptions) => { abort(): void } \| undefined` | Sends a file: report the progress and the result with the callbacks in `options`. Return an object with `abort()` to let "Remove" cancel the request. Without `customRequest` and `action`, files are only added to the list. | — | No |
| `action` | `string` | Address that receives each file as a `multipart/form-data` POST, when `customRequest` is not given. | — | No |
| `name` | `string` | Name of the file field in the POST to `action`. | `'file'` | No |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | Allows choosing several files at once. | — | No |
| `maxCount` | `number` | Largest number of files in the list; with `1`, a new file replaces the old one. | — | No |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disables choosing and removing files. | — | No |
| `fileList` | `readonly UploadFile[]` | The files in the list (controlled). | — | No |
| `defaultFileList` | `readonly UploadFile[]` | Initial files (uncontrolled), such as attachments already saved. | — | No |
| `onChange` | `(info: UploadChangeInfo) => void` | Called when files are added, change state or are removed. | — | No |
| `onRemove` | `(file: UploadFile) => boolean \| undefined \| Promise<boolean \| undefined>` | Called before a file is removed; return `false` (or a promise of it) to keep it. | — | No |
| `onPreview` | `(file: UploadFile) => void` | Called when the name of a file in the list is clicked, such as to preview it. | — | No |
| `showUploadList` | `boolean` | Shows the file list below the trigger: name, size or progress, "Retry" for failed files and "Remove". | `true` | No |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | The trigger, usually a Button. Pressing it opens the file dialog; focus stays on it. | — | No |
| `data-testid` | `string` | Test id, output as `data-testid`. | — | No |

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
